data.description: SQL编程练习 - ALTER TABLE修改表

text:
-- 添加新列
ALTER TABLE users
ADD COLUMN phone VARCHAR(20),
ADD COLUMN address TEXT;

-- 修改列定义
ALTER TABLE users
MODIFY COLUMN email VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL;

-- 删除列
ALTER TABLE users
DROP COLUMN address;

-- 添加索引
ALTER TABLE users
ADD INDEX idx_email (email),
ADD INDEX idx_city_status (city, status);

-- 添加外键约束
ALTER TABLE orders
ADD CONSTRAINT fk_user
FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id)
ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE;

-- 重命名表
ALTER TABLE old_users RENAME TO users_backup;

-- 修改列名
ALTER TABLE users
CHANGE COLUMN old_name new_name VARCHAR(100);
